meta.title: Shiga Kogen Mountain Resort
meta.description: 1–1.2 hours from Nagano Station — Japan's mega mountain resort with 18 areas, 84 runs, and premium powder.

transit.title:
From Nagano,
into the plateau.
transit.lead: ~70 minutes by express bus from JR Nagano Station, or ~1–1.2 hours by car — into Japan's largest mountain resort with 18 linked ski areas. A rental car makes loops to Yudanaka, Shibu onsen, and Jigokudani snow monkeys easy to plan.
transit.imgAlt: Snowy drive from Nagano toward Shiga Kogen — highland mountain scenery

primary.title: Scale you cannot ski in one day
primary.lead: 425 ha, 84 runs, up to 6,000 m longest descent — one all-mountain pass links 18 areas. At 2,307 m, dry inland powder and a dispersed layout keep lift lines shorter than many mega-resorts.
primary.imgAlt: Skier on vast Shiga Kogen slopes — plateau panorama and deep snow

secondary.title: After skiing, onsen towns & snow monkeys
secondary.lead: Kumanoyu, Shibu onsen, Yudanaka — compensate for thin après-ski on the plateau with foothill hot-spring towns and the famous snow monkeys.

onsen.title:
Kumanoyu &
Shibu onsen loop
onsen.lead: From Kumanoyu inside the resort to 700-year-old Shibu onsen and emerald Happu springs — post-ski recovery and foothill base-town stays are easy to design.
onsen.whisper: Dinner options are limited on the plateau — routing down to Shibu or Yudanaka for evening meals is a local favorite.
onsen.imgAlt: Steam from snow-view outdoor bath — Shiga Kogen and Shibu onsen

kumanoyu.title: Kumanoyu Onsen (Kumanoyu Hotel)
kumanoyu.lead: Hirune 7148, Yamanouchi, Nagano. Iconic Shiga Kogen hot spring known for strong acidic water. TEL 0269-34-2311 (verify on official site).
kumanoyu.imgAlt: Outdoor bath at Kumanoyu — classic Shiga Kogen onsen

shibu.title: Shibu Onsen (inn association)
shibu.lead: Hirune 2115, Yamanouchi. Over 1,350 years of history — stroll nine public baths in a wooden streetscape. TEL 0269-33-2921 (verify).

happu.title: Happu Onsen (Shiga Swiss Inn)
happu.lead: Hirune 7149, Yamanouchi. Emerald-green water and steam vents — distinctive resort-linked springs. TEL 0269-34-3456 (verify).
happu.imgAlt: Emerald pool at Happu Onsen — Shiga Kogen

daruma.title: Daruma Shokudo
daruma.lead: Ichinose, Shiga Kogen, Yamanouchi — Hotel Japan Shiga 1F. Popular meat dishes with Shinshu beef — a central-area lunch staple. TEL 0269-34-2801 (verify).
daruma.imgAlt: Shinshu beef dish at Daruma Shokudo — Ichinose area

yokote.title: Yokote-yama Drive-In
yokote.lead: Hirune 7149, Yamanouchi. Hand-cut soba with views from ~2,100 m — a Yokote-yama landmark. TEL 0269-34-2338 (verify).
yokote.imgAlt: Scenic soba at Yokote Drive-In — Shiga Kogen

powder.title: Japan-scale terrain & JAPOW
powder.body: 1,341–2,307 m elevation and 425 ha — inland dry powder from late November through late May. One pass links 18 areas and 84 runs in a rare all-mountain experience.

nagano.title: ~70 min bus from Nagano Station
nagano.body: Express bus ~70 minutes or car ~1–1.2 hours from JR Nagano — pair with the Hokuriku Shinkansen for weekend trips. Rent at Nagano Station for Yudanaka, Shibu, and snow-monkey loops.

eco.title: UNESCO eco-park wilderness
eco.body: Inside Joshin'etsu Kogen National Park and a UNESCO eco-park — pristine nature and high elevation stabilize snow quality. A dispersed layout appeals to guests avoiding crowded mega-resorts.

access.note: ~1–1.2 h by car or ~70 min express bus from Nagano Station (typical)
